project.name: Crick Townscape Guide

properties.name: Crick curated visitor boundary
properties.originalSourceDataset: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
properties.methodology: Morphological closing of the preserved official built-up-area geometry using a 150 metre outward and inward buffer. This fills internal omissions for connected parks, river corridors and visitor green spaces without applying a general outward town buffer.

project.boundarySource: Curated Crick visitor boundary derived from ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-09. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary.
